jobs.title: SAP Business Systems Manager, Allentown Plant
jobs.content: <p>Kettlebrook Foods is a family-owned maker of soups and sauces.</p><h3>About the role</h3><p>We are opening a new production facility in Allentown and need a hands-on SAP lead to own the plant’s S/4HANA rollout from blueprint through hypercare. You will configure PP, QM and WM, coordinate the integration partner, and run the plant systems team after go-live.</p><ul><li>Lead fit-gap and UAT for the new plant</li><li>Own EDI with co-packers and 3PLs</li></ul><p>Hybrid, 3 days on site. Travel up to 15% to our Camden, NJ plant.</p><p>The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000.</p><p>Kettlebrook Foods is an equal opportunity employer.</p>

jobs.title: Manufacturing IT Lead
jobs.content: <h3>The role</h3><p>Own plant-floor systems at our Camden kitchen: MES on Ignition, label printing, and scale integrations. You’ll lead post-go-live stabilization of our new SAP system and keep USDA and HACCP records audit-ready.</p>
